title: senna italica subsp. arachoides
intro: Senna italica subsp. arachoides, commonly known as a medicinal plant, is a subspecies of Senna italica, a flowering plant in the pea family. This plant is known for its traditional use in treating various health issues, including constipation, fever, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Senna italica subsp. arachoides include purgation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
